One keystroke in a sort-field grid during that save (an ordinary `line_no` column is enough) strips every created line's id, so the next save deletes and re-creates them all, silently. Duplicate writes and silent id churn are data integrity, the objectui#10564 family (p1), which outranks the road ⇒ p1.
